title: Grade 3 French — Wed, Jun 25
description: À l'école — Day 3 of 5: School actions (les actions à l'école — –er verbs)
subject: french

questions.question: What does 'écrire' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Écrire' = to write. A very common school action.

questions.question: What does 'lire' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Lire' = to read. 'Je lis un livre.' = I am reading a book.

questions.question: What does 'écouter' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Écouter' = to listen. 'J'écoute le professeur.' = I listen to the teacher.

questions.question: What does 'parler' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Parler' = to speak/talk. 'Je parle français.' = I speak French.

questions.question: What does 'dessiner' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Dessiner' = to draw. 'Je dessine un arbre.' = I draw a tree.

questions.question: Complete: 'En classe, j'___ le professeur attentivement.' (In class, I listen to the teacher carefully.)
questions.explanation: 'J'écoute le professeur attentivement.' = I listen to the teacher carefully. 'Écouter' = to listen.

questions.question: What does 'travailler' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Travailler' = to work/study. 'Je travaille dur.' = I work hard.

questions.question: Translate: 'She reads a book in the library.'
options: Elle lit un livre dans la bibliothèque.
Elle écrit un livre dans la bibliothèque.
Elle écoute un livre dans la bibliothèque.
Elle mange un livre dans la bibliothèque.
questions.explanation: 'Elle lit un livre dans la bibliothèque.' = She reads a book in the library. 'Lire' → il/elle lit.

questions.question: Match: 'poser une question' means:
questions.explanation: 'Poser une question' = to ask a question. 'Répondre à une question' = to answer a question.

questions.question: What does 'lever la main' mean in a classroom context?
questions.explanation: 'Lever la main' = to raise your hand (to answer a question or get the teacher's attention).

questions.question: Translate: 'We write in our notebooks.'
questions.explanation: 'Nous écrivons dans nos cahiers.' = We write in our notebooks. 'Écrire' → nous écrivons.

questions.question: What is the difference between 'écouter' and 'entendre'?
options: 'Écouter' = to actively listen (intentional); 'entendre' = to hear (passively receiving sound)
'Entendre' = to listen in class; 'écouter' = to hear music
questions.explanation: 'Écouter' = to listen actively (you choose to pay attention). 'Entendre' = to hear (you passively receive the sound). 'J'écoute de la musique' (I listen to music) vs 'J'entends du bruit' (I hear noise).

questions.question: Translate: 'He speaks French and draws well.'
options: Il parle français et dessine bien.
Il lit français et écrit bien.
Il écoute français et dessine bien.
Il parle français et lit bien.
questions.explanation: 'Il parle français et dessine bien.' = He speaks French and draws well. Both verbs are in the il form: parle (parler), dessine (dessiner).

questions.question: Describe a school day using 4 different action verbs. Best answer:
options: Je mange, je mange, je mange, je mange.
Le matin, j'écoute le professeur. J'écris dans mon cahier. Je lis un livre. Je dessine un arbre.
Je vais à l'école et je reviens.
J'ai un sac et des crayons.
questions.explanation: The best answer uses 4 different verbs (écouter, écrire, lire, dessiner) in complete sentences describing a school day. Variety shows vocabulary range.

questions.question: Why is 'lever la main' an important classroom rule in France?
options: It shows respect, lets the teacher manage turns and prevents everyone from speaking at once
Teachers in France make it compulsory by law
It helps students learn new words
questions.explanation: 'Lever la main' is a social convention to show you want to speak. It maintains classroom order, shows respect for the teacher and ensures everyone gets a fair turn.
